findings.title: User-provided Warp kernel code executed through exec_module without validation
findings.description: The _compile method (line 206) injects user-provided snippet code into a Python function template via str.format, writes the generated module to a temp directory (line 240), and imports it via exec_module (line 249). While the user code is inside a @wp.kernel function body, it still passes through Python's full compilation pipeline and through Warp's function tracer during kernel launch. No validation, sanitization, or user warning is performed on snippet code before compilation.
findings.impact: A crafted snippet could cause GPU-side issues (CUDA driver crash, cross-process GPU memory read) or exploit Warp's kernel tracing mechanism. Users are not warned they are executing arbitrary GPU code.
findings.fix: Add a user-facing security acknowledgment before enabling custom snippets. Validate snippet code for known dangerous patterns or disallowed operations. Document the security boundary clearly in the UI ('This executes arbitrary code on your GPU').

findings.title: Unrestricted file write path in export_frame operator
findings.description: The FLUIDSIM_OT_export_frame operator accepts a filepath StringProperty with subtype FILE_PATH (line 447). At line 457, bpy.path.abspath(self.filepath) resolves the path without any restriction against directory traversal.
findings.impact: Files (OBJ mesh data, PLY particle data) can be written to arbitrary locations the Blender process has write access to.
findings.fix: Resolve paths relative to the .blend file directory and validate they remain within an allowed output directory.

findings.title: Unrestricted file write path in write_report operator
findings.description: The FLUIDSIM_OT_write_report operator (line 327) writes a JSON diagnostics report to a user-configurable path without directory restriction.
findings.impact: JSON diagnostic data can be written to arbitrary filesystem locations.
findings.fix: Resolve and validate paths against the .blend file directory.

findings.title: Unrestricted file read/write path in benchmark baseline operator
findings.description: The FLUIDSIM_OT_run_benchmark operator resolves the benchmark_baseline path via bpy.path.abspath() without directory restriction.
findings.impact: JSON files can be read from and written to arbitrary filesystem locations.
findings.fix: Restrict benchmark baseline path to the .blend project directory.

findings.title: Unrestricted cache directory creation at user-controlled path
findings.description: The write_frame function resolves cache_path via bpy.path.abspath(fs.cache_path) and calls os.makedirs(base, exist_ok=True) to create the directory tree. The cache_path property allows arbitrary paths.
findings.impact: Directory trees can be created and .npz files written to arbitrary filesystem locations.
findings.fix: Restrict cache directory to a subdirectory of the .blend file location.

findings.title: Predictable temp directory for generated snippet modules with TOCTOU race
findings.description: Compiled snippet modules are written to a hardcoded temp path using os.makedirs and open(path, 'w') without O_EXCL flag. Filenames derived from content hash are predictable.
findings.impact: Symlink race could redirect .py file writes to attacker-chosen locations.
findings.fix: Use O_CREAT | O_EXCL in open() to fail if the file already exists.
